summary: Extracted the S007 decide()/reconcile logic out of bot/s007_paper.py::live() into a reusable run_cycle_for_account(creds, preset, risk_pct, fixed_lot, use_fixed_lot, magic, logger, ...) function, parameterized instead of hardcoded to bot.s007_config globals; live() now just calls it with the module defaults, so the single-account CLI behaviour is unchanged (verified via --dry-run regression). Rewrote webapp/runner.py for the new broker-agnostic multi-strategy schema (User/Account/AccountStrategy/Strategy) as a coordinator+worker pair: "python -m webapp.runner --strategy S007" loads enabled AccountStrategy rows and spawns one worker subprocess per account (because CTraderAdapter drives its session through a single reactor.run() call -- Twisted reactors cannot be restarted in the same process, so parallel accounts within one tick require one OS process each, not threads/asyncio); a worker runs exactly one cycle for one account_strategy id and exits. Curated events (cycle_start/cycle_end/position_open/position_close/error) now also write to the DB logs table via webapp/schemas/logs.py; full per-tick debug detail (and the label_was_opened/closed dedup state decide() depends on) still goes to per-account utils.trade_logger.StrategyLogger JSONL files under reports/logs/ -- NOT yet safe to drop for containerization, since that dedup state currently only lives in those files (open item). Rewrote webapp/cli.py for the same new schema (init-db/create-user/add-account/add-strategy/link-strategy/enable/disable/list), reusing webapp/schemas/ for validation. S009/Bybit multi-account support deliberately NOT done here: bot/s009_paper.py keeps its ledger state in one shared file for the whole strategy (load_state/save_state), not per (account, strategy), so it would need its own refactor before it could run several accounts in parallel the same way.

Added docs/DEV_PLANS.md, a new dev-plans doc capturing the decided multi-account Docker migration architecture (stateless-tick scheduling, per-strategy job granularity, DB-as-source-of-truth, DB schema decisions, logging split, Alembic migration convention, accounts.yml import mapping) and its current build status, so this is tracked in-repo instead of only in Claude memory. Linked it from README.md's docs/ listing.
